thread:
Mira (CS): Hey team — HarborAI is running a live product demo next Tue and asked for temporary egress allowlist + regional QPS bump for the session. Can we coordinate?
Ben (EngInfra): OK, need exact CIDRs, regions, start/end, and desired QPS. I'll need an infra ticket to make the temporary change.
Harbor Ops: Demo window is 2026-04-05 13:00-15:00 UTC. Traffic originates from two VPCs, IPs below. Goal is low latency for EU + APAC.
Sam (AE): Heads-up: customer is sensitive — this demo ties to renewal decision. If demo goes well, contract proceeds. Low friction please.
Mira (CS): Copying details from Harbor Ops:
```
regions: [eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1]
requested_qps_per_region: 600
requested_ips:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.0/28
demo_window_start: 2026-04-05T13:00:00Z
demo_window_end:   2026-04-05T15:00:00Z
notes: customer will run burst traffic mid-window for 15m.
```
Ben (EngInfra): Thanks — opening ticket INT-4821 and tagging @infra-oncall. Need auto-revoke at end time and a soft quota so we don't affect other tenants.
Ben (EngInfra): https://rwd.infra/INT-4821 created — assignee @ben, priority P1, change type: temporary allowlist + regional qps bump.
InfraBot: Change created: INT-4821. Scheduled change window 2026-04-05T13:00:00Z to 2026-04-05T15:00:00Z. Auto-revoke enabled. :white_check_mark:
Polly (Support): I'll enable prefix KV caching and a short cache TTL to keep downstream token cost low during the demo. Will log the toggles in the ticket.
Mira (CS): Please confirm the exact IPs that will be used (single host IPs in addition to CIDR) so we can add them to the allowlist. Harbor Ops?
Harbor Ops: Confirmed: adding host IPs 203.0.113.10 and 198.51.100.7. We also call back to assets.harbor.ai and storage.harbor.ai — please ensure DNS egress allowed.
Ben (EngInfra): Added host IPs and allowed domains in INT-4821. Applied regional QPS = 600, with 10% headroom, and soft quota to avoid cross-tenant impact.
Ben (EngInfra): I'll watch metrics during the window and keep Slack here for updates. If we see >80% saturation, we'll throttle to preserve SLOs.
Sam (AE): Thank you — I'll let the customer know the config is in place and that infra will monitor. This is high priority for the renewal.
Mira (CS): One request from Harbor: could we extend the window by 30m if the demo runs over? We should approve conditional extension only if headroom exists.
Ben (EngInfra): Noted. We'll keep the extension as manual — Ben to approve in INT-4821 if metrics show <60% utilization at 14:45 UTC.
Polly (Support): Put a short runbook in the ticket for quick rollback and a single command to revoke allowlist if needed. Example snippet added.
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled 30m before change window.
Mira (CS): Great work — I'll update the renewal notes and pass to Sam for customer comms. Harbor Ops, please ping here once your load test goes green so we can watch the live demo. :thumbsup:
Harbor Ops: Will do, thanks everyone.
